title: A Spoon of Neutron Star Weighs Billions of Tons
description: A single teaspoon of neutron star material would weigh billions of tons on Earth.

scenes.text: A single teaspoon of a neutron star would weigh billions of tons here on Earth.
scenes.subject: star
scenes.say: [whispers] A single teaspoon of a neutron star... [gasps] would weigh BILLIONS of tons here on Earth.

scenes.text: A neutron star is what can be left after a giant star explodes. Its core collapses into a tiny ball.
scenes.subject: supernova

scenes.text: It packs more mass than our Sun into a sphere about the size of a city.
scenes.subject: city
scenes.say: It packs more mass than our Sun into a sphere about the size of a city.

scenes.text: Gravity there is so strong that atoms are crushed together, until they are mostly packed neutrons.

scenes.text: The heaviest spoonful in the universe. Follow for more weird facts.
